prompt.description: Natural-language description of the image to synthesize. Runner forwards to the configured frontier image model; provider-specific prompt limits apply.

negative_prompt.description: Optional content the model should avoid. Honored only when the active frontier backend supports negative prompting.

size.description: Output dimensions, width x height in pixels. Closed enum aligned with the union of supported frontier sizes; runner rejects unsupported combinations for the active backend.

n.description: Number of distinct images to generate. Each counts as one billed invocation upstream.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed. Reproducibility depends on the upstream provider honoring seeds.

style.description: Optional stylistic hint forwarded as a backend-native style parameter where supported (e.g. 'natural', 'vivid').

images.description: One sandbox reference per generated image. Files are written to mesh-owned scratch space and expire per lab policy; downstream cards consume them by image_ref.

model.description: Concrete frontier model id that produced the image(s) for receipt citation.

revised_prompt.description: If the backend rewrote the prompt (DALL-E behavior), the rewritten form is returned for transparency.

summary: Text-to-image synthesis via an operator-supplied frontier backend; outputs land in mesh-scoped sandbox storage.
notes: Operator must supply the frontier credential via Hermes secret 'frontier.image'. Generation is irreversible from a billing standpoint, so the default lease requires per-invocation human approval; lower that ceiling only after a budget envelope is in place.
